claims.text: Each treatment was applied to six plots in a randomized complete block design.
claims.summary: The plot map in Fig. 1 shows six blocks with both treatments in each.

claims.text: Mean yield was 4.1 kg per plant in mulched plots and 3.2 kg per plant in unmulched plots.
claims.summary: Table 1 gives these means with standard deviations and six plots per treatment.

claims.text: Mulching to 10 cm increased yield by 28%.
claims.summary: 4.1 / 3.2 = 1.28, and the difference is about four standard errors.

claims.text: The yield increase is caused by reduced evaporation from the soil.
basis: paper: Methods, soil moisture was not measured
claims.summary: Soil moisture was never measured, and weed suppression or soil warming would give the same result.

claims.text: This is the largest yield response to mulch reported for tomato.
claims.summary: An earlier study reports a 35% response under deeper mulch.

claims.text: Soil nitrogen did not differ between treatments (Table S2).
basis: paper: Table S2 was not supplied
claims.summary: The evidence is in supplementary material that was not available.
